name: Invigorate
body:
When you heal others you aid their spirit and flesh.

Prerequisite(s): Class feature which restores hit points to other creatures.

Benefit: Whenever you use a class feature that restores hit points to a creature other than yourself, you also gird them against other ailments. For 10 minutes, the affected creature gains a bonus on saves against poison and disease equal to 1/4 your character level. If the creature is currently suffering from the effects of any disease or poison they may make a new save against that effect as a free action when healed by you. A creature can only benefit from this feat once per day.
